coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only; include counties with observed EPA annual PM2.5 and non-suppressed CDC Atlas outcome; no unsupported completeness cutoff.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The complete article does not name an exposure source. EPA AQS is a public regulatory monitor archive with usable 2020–2022 annual PM2.5 records. The current public Atlas exposes 2020–2022 rather than 2016–2020. This is a bounded analysis retaining county ecological spatial support, target outcomes, PM2.5, and OLS model family while explicitly changing exposure implementation, period, and adjustment.
evidence_basis: EPA annual archives yield 643 counties with PM2.5 and 551 ischemic-outcome/exposure overlaps; CDC Atlas produces 2020–2022 age-65+ county outcome records.
CDC Atlas configuration documents Ischemic Stroke and Hemorrhagic Stroke death-rate themes and age/race/sex/time filters.
